description_en: Invites a SIP endpoint to join a channel
kebab_example: aliyun rtc rtc-sip-invite-member --app-id 'eo85****' --channel-id '$rtc_channelid' --uid '$rtc_userid' --device-type phone --registered false --sip-display-name testdevice --sip-user-id '$reg_userid' --sip-room-id 18512514528 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RtcSipInviteMember

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the device used to call the third-party SIP endpoint. Valid values:
sip_device
mcu
phone

Note: Currently, only the phone type is supported
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫第三方sip的设备类型：
sip_device
mcu
phone

备注：当前阶段，仅支持phone类型
parameters.name: device_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the nearest RTC SIP server.
You can resolve the domain name rtcsip.dingtalk.com locally to obtain the nearest access address.
For example, run dig rtcsip.dingtalk.com to obtain the address
parameters.help_zh:
就近接入 rtc sip 服务器IP地址。
用户通过本地进行解析域名:rtcsip.dingtalk.com获取到就近接入地址。
如: dig rtcsip.dingtalk.com获取
parameters.name: server_address

parameters.help_en: The meeting token. For code generation, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2689025.html
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the third-party meeting system requires registration for inbound calls
parameters.help_zh: 第三方会议系统是否要注册呼入
parameters.name: registered

parameters.help_en: The username displayed on the third-party system
parameters.name: sip_display_name

parameters.help_en:
When DeviceType is mcu, it represents the third-party meeting system.
When DeviceType is sip_device, it represents the registered device.
If the third-party meeting system requires registration for inbound calls, it is the account provided by the third-party system to create an account.
If registration is not required, it is the SIP username or RTC user ID for calling the third-party system
parameters.help_zh:
当DeviceType = mcu ，代表第三方会议系统
当DeviceType = sip_device  代表注册设备
如果第三方会议系统要求注册呼入，则为第三方系统提供的注册账号
如果不需要注册呼叫，则为呼入第三方的sip用户名rtc userid
parameters.name: sip_user_id

parameters.help_en: The registration password that matches the SipUserId if the third-party system requires registration for inbound calls
parameters.help_zh: 如果第三方要注册呼入，匹配SipUserId的注册密码
parameters.name: sip_user_password

parameters.help_en:
When the device is mcu, it indicates the channel number of the third-party meeting system to be called.
When the device is sip_device, it indicates the registration number of the registered device to be invited.
When the device is phone, it indicates the called phone number
parameters.help_zh:
当设备是mcu时，表示呼入的第三方会议系统的频道号码
当设备是sip_device时，表示要邀请的注册设备的注册号码
当设备是phone时，表示被叫的电话号码
parameters.name: sip_room_id

parameters.help_en:
When the device is mcu, it indicates the address information of the third-party meeting system in the format of ip:port;transport=tcp/udp/tls.
Example: "30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
When the device is sip_device, it indicates the registration address of the registered device to be invited.
Example: 39.101.232.13
When the device is phone, it indicates the address information of the telephone gateway.
Example: "30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
parameters.help_zh:
当设备是mcu 表示第三方会议系统的地址信息ip:port;transport=tcp/udp/tls
如："30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
当设备是sip_device 表示要邀请的注册设备的注册地址
如: 39.101.232.13
当设备是phone 表示电话网关的地址信息
如："30.240.160.66:5060;transport=tcp"
parameters.name: sip_uri

parameters.help_en: The brand and model of the third-party SIP endpoint being called, such as polycom, cisco, tencent, zoom, or pstn
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫第三方sip的品牌型号 如polycom/cisco/tencent/zoom/pstn
parameters.name: sip_user_agent

parameters.help_en: The custom line number in PSTN scenarios
parameters.help_zh: pstn场景下自定义线路号码
parameters.name: call_number
